chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: عَنْ حَمْدَوَيْهَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: From Hamduwayh, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Hammad who said:

chunks.arabic_text: كَانَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَأْمُرُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ أَنْ يُجَالِسَ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَيُكَلِّمَهُمْ وَيُخَاصِمَهُمْ حَتَّى كَلَّمَهُمْ فِي صَاحِبِ الْقَبْرِ وَكَانَ إِذَا انْصَرَفَ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ: مَا قُلْتُمْ لَهُمْ وَمَا قَالُوا لَكُمْ وَيَرْضَى بِذَلِكَ مِنْهُ

translations.en: Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) used to order Muhammad ibn Hakim to sit with the people of Madinah in the Masjid of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and to speak with them and debate with them, so he even spoke with them regarding the companion of the grave. And when he would return to him, he would ask: What did you say to them and what did they say to you? And he would be pleased with that from him.

en.summary: This narration from Rijal al-Kashshi describes how Imam Abu al-Hasan (AS) instructed Muhammad ibn Hakim to engage in public discourse and debate with the people of Madinah in the Prophet's Mosque, specifically discussing the companion of the grave (Abu Bakr). The Imam would inquire about the details of the debate and expressed satisfaction with Ibn Hakim's performance.
en.seo_question: How did Imam al-Rida (AS) instruct his companion to debate the people of Madinah regarding the companion of the grave?

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan (Imam al-Rida, peace be upon him)
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ: Muhammad ibn Hakim (a companion of the Imams)
key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْقَبْرِ: The companion of the grave (referring to Abu Bakr)
